definitions: A soft, spongy confection, typically made from sugar, gelatin, and egg white, often coated in cornstarch.
A plant (Althaea officinalis) native to Europe and Asia, with a mucilaginous root formerly used for medicinal purposes and in confectionery.
examples: She toasted a marshmallow over the campfire.
The recipe called for a bag of mini marshmallows.
Marshmallow root has been used in traditional medicine.
